name: Apple Slices with Cinnamon-Honey Peanut Butter
instructions: Place peanut butter, honey, and cinnamon in a small bowl. Mash and combine with the back of a spoon until smooth. Set aside.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; slice into wedges.
Divide apples between plates. Serve with cinnamon-honey peanut butter for dipping. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
